source_scope: Existing bound public MR230/Pallox512 and explicitly source-only synthetic OLD6144/NEW20480 artifacts; no V112 or private/current223 body access, including hashing.
all_rows_policy: Retain every MR1840, Pallox512 and source-synthetic row, original IDs, fixed split, weak state, role/entity targets, availability, construction flags, and separate quality label. Unknown/unavailable rows remain in row outputs and denominators; descriptive cosine eligibility requires available and constructed finite nonzero component.
score_policy: Read all four C35/C36/C37/C38 FIT_COMPLETE/SOURCE_RESULTS and their exact saved FINAL source-output NPZ bindings, with no arm selection. Reproduce original binary sign threshold zero only, no threshold search or calibration. Evaluate visibility only for original D/E role target known; entity separately; quality separately when explicitly bound.
distance_policy: Cosine distances on existing frozen raw descriptors only. Full raw feature and exactly code-verified DINO component slices are reported separately. No fitting, scaling learned from data, dimensionality reduction, model/probe/encoder/weight loading or forward.
nearest_policy: Query train and held available MR rows against available TRAIN references. Exclude same frame for TRAIN leave-frame-out comparisons. For each original material-state label compute nearest same-state and different-state distances and their ratio d_same/d_different; undefined or zero-denominator quantities remain null. Also report nearest reference ID and labels. D/E cross-state overlaps use original labels and exclude same-frame comparisons; same-frame D/E coexistence/context equality is reported separately.
context_policy: Frame-context summaries deduplicate identical per-frame global blocks; one original first eligible row per frame. Keep all 45 held frame error summaries, including zero errors and zero known labels. Saved error concentration uses counts, frame totals and top fixed 5/10 frames per arm; no causality or statistical independence claim from repeated rows.
auxiliary_policy: Trace synthetic bindings only through source-only helper protocol metadata, reject any forbidden path before filesystem access. Report all rows and original splits; descriptive component nearest distances from eligible MR queries to eligible synthetic/Pallox TRAIN sources may be computed in bounded batches without fitting. No relabeling or promotion of weak labels to gold.
reporting: Machine JSON/CSVs and reproducible source/code/output SHA256, compact aggregate printout. Scientific PNG may summarize saved errors and frozen-distance distributions. Findings are descriptive source support or overlap, never causal assertions, arm/checkpoint adoption, or new training authorization.
